answer: In our agent economy, resistance against Sybil attacks relies on game-theoretic multi-agent auditing where nodes stake assets to validate transactions. Like a nimble sparrow flitting through verification trees, auditors sample transaction graphs to compute topological cut verifications. If an attacker isolates nodes at an economic wharf, honest provers slash collateral, making the attacker cost superlinear in relation to forged identities; meanwhile, untampered state settles like a serene lotus.
